note: Per task: passed_with = cross | print | null; sims_to_pass = simulations until the passing design was accepted (Cross+Print counts the 30 of Cross); light / fast value = mass (g) / time (s) of the best accepted Light / Fast design, else of the passing design (from = pass), null if neither; designs/ holds every accepted design; all_in_one: courses passed in simulation and on the real courses. rules: the rules each design was accepted under (start boards or the courses as built, the chain-loop limit, the cross-axle 90-deg rule); the benchmark's rules for new runs are start boards on, at most 2 chain loops and the cross-axle rule; tests/selftest.py re-judges each design under its own rules.
